prompt: The provided ReceiptSection has a final public render() and two protected hooks. Write ReceiptStyler by overriding only those hooks. Complete the starter file, then run the tests.
explanation: protected is the access level that means "part of the contract with subclasses, not with the outside world": decorate and banner are invisible to ordinary callers but open to any class that extends ReceiptSection. Keeping render() public and final fixes the shape of the output while still letting subclasses vary the pieces. An override may widen visibility but never narrow it, so a protected hook must stay protected or become public.
hints: Add methods with exactly the signatures protected String decorate(String line) and protected String banner(String text), and mark them @Override.
In decorate, trim the line first, then test whether what is left is empty (and guard against a null line).
banner is called for the title and again for the word "end", so uppercase whatever text it is given rather than hard-coding either one.
